ListPreference.android:summary: Euclidean (default; affine view) or Poincaré disk (the Circle Limit projection)

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Boundary compression
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: How strongly the projection piles up tiles against the disk boundary. Low → an even radial squeeze, tiles fill the screen, disk boundary off-screen. High → far tiles compress against the boundary and the disk edge becomes visible — the Circle Limit feel. The view auto-fits the projected tiling to the screen, so the slider only controls compression, never visibility.

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Disk centre — X
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Hyperbolic translation along the X axis. 50 = centred at the origin; 0/100 shifts the disk centre to b ≈ (-0.9, 0) / (+0.9, 0).

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Disk centre — Y
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Hyperbolic translation along the Y axis. 50 = centred at the origin.

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Border arc subdivision
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Splits each tile-edge border into N straight sub-segments before projection. Cost is linear in N. 1 = single chord; 8–16 reads as a smooth geodesic arc near the disk boundary; 32 caps it. Triggers a geometry rebuild.

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Fill arc subdivision
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Splits each fill triangle into N² child triangles (barycentric grid; bevels stay on parent edges via linear-interpolated barycentrics). Cost is N², so the slider caps lower than the border. 1 = chord-filled tile; 4 reads as smooth; 8 is the ceiling — past that vertex memory grows uncomfortably at high tile counts. Triggers a geometry rebuild.
